notes: Stories created for Trial Phase Quality measure.

stories.title: Define Trial Phase Quality Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a normalized schema for clinical trial phase (I, II, III, IV) and corresponding quality score mapping, including handling for missing or unknown phase values.

stories.title: Implement Trial Phase Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to map trial phases (I-IV) to a quality score reflecting maturity and validation, including deterministic scoring rules and fallback behavior for incomplete data.

stories.title: Expose Trial Phase Quality via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate trial phase quality scoring into the clinical trials response payload returned by the Evaluate Care facade, ensuring compatibility with existing trial search outputs.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Trial Phase Quality
stories.description: Create unit tests for phase-to-score mapping and edge cases, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow from clinical trials service through Evaluate Care facade output.
